title: AIS Traffic Density by Marina Entrance
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:ais entrance_name=*
| stats count as ais_contacts by entrance_name
| sort - ais_contacts
description: Ranks marina entrance by AIS contacts volume for marina approaches.
value: Volume rankings show which marina entrance are producing the most activity, demand, or friction inside marina approaches.
implementation: Capture each AIS contacts as a `marine:ais` event and normalize `entrance_name` so the totals are comparable.
visualization: Bar chart of AIS contacts volume by marina entrance.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which marina entrance show up the most in marina approaches so you know where the busiest areas are.
